owner_decision: EW2-8 to EW2-12 (2026-10-08): new sources only; choose on development frames only; the reserved frames are spent

family.admission_rule: (a) within lb95 above 0 and point at or above the head's floor on that side; (b) Holm-adjusted permutation p below 0.05 inside the wave family; (c) the twin inside its floor; (d) DS-06 admitted the column in every fold and the fold deltas share one sign; (e) contributor AUC not adverse beyond its floor; (f) any missingness indicator BALANCED under the DS-03 probe; (g) the pooled secondary not adverse beyond its floor (reported)

k_resid.k_resid_h: z(k_h) - b x z(swstr_h), b the pool's least-squares slope
k_resid.k_resid_p: z(k_p) - b x z(swstr_p), b the pool's least-squares slope

construction.z: inside each (level, season) pool: unweighted mean and sd over lines with at least norm_min exposure; every player at the pool, never a frame row
construction.as_of: the last two played seasons ending before the read (efv_dataset._milb_features rule; 2020 skipped)
construction.id: list vintage: the outcome-blind mlbam_id (efv_identity), never record_mlbam_id; matrix row: the matrix id, as base V2 reads it
construction.missing: no line in a complete pool: None (imputed at the fold's training mean on a full frame); pbp_absent is a DS-03 balance probe only

w_star_dev.convention: the k-th largest W3 on the rows, k = the number of six-season contributors; development convention on the fwar label, re-derived by EV-05 on the frozen label

restriction.rule: each side's arms are read on its has-full-pbp slots only: every column of the side has a value; training, test and scored rows of every fold restricted; the V2 assembly refit on the kept training rows is the base; every frame player of the fold is still excluded from its training rows
restriction.why: pbp_absent proxies level (A ball had no pitch events before 2016) and never enters a skill head; the restriction removes it from the comparison instead of imputing over it
